 Pump.fun Ends Cashback for New Token Launches, Introduces Holder Rewards
 Phemex News 2026/09/14 15:20

 Pump.fun has discontinued cashback for new token launches and shifted to a holder-rewards model. Wallets holding positions worth at least $20 can now receive trading-fee payouts multiple times per hour.
Existing cashback tokens must reapply to participate in the new rewards program.
